plugin.plugin_emojimanager.name: Emoji Manager
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.description: Members pick an emoji image from a private menu (/emoji-menu show); the bot posts it big in the channel. Images are uploaded on the dashboard or with /emoji-menu add.
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.setting.emoji: Name (a-z, 0-9, _ and -) and an image: upload it here, or give an https link. /emoji-menu add and delete change this list too. The menu shows the first 25; /emoji-menu show name sends any of them.
Optional: an https link, used when no image is uploaded.
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.setting.serve: Also offer the server's own emojis
The custom emojis of the server (after the list). Needs the SDK permission discord.emojis.read.
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.node.menu.des: Answers the command with a private menu of the emojis; the pick is posted in the channel.
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.node.menu.con: Emoji name (optional: send it right away)
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.node.send.des: Posts one emoji by name, big, in a channel.
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.setting.emoji: PNG, GIF, WEBP or JPEG, max. 2 MB.
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.setting.manag: Who may add and delete emojis
For /emoji-menu add and /emoji-menu delete. Default: members with "Manage Expressions".
plugin.plugin_emojimanager.node.manage.d: Adds an emoji (image from a Discord attachment or a link) to the list, or deletes one. Only for the "managers" of the settings page.
